games.name: [🥚] Levelbound
games.desc:
Fight through modular dungeons, loot epic gear, level up, choose a class, unlock skills, master a subclass, join a guild, party with friends, trade, climb leaderboards. Player driven economy, auction house, trade stalls, ranked pvp, dungeon invasions, world bosses; what will you do in this MMORPG-like cooperative dungeon crawler?

🍀 2x Luck active on weekends
⌛ Frequent updates and events

Player Level Cap: 90
Equipment Level Cap: 100

Classes: Warrior, Assassin, Tank, Ranger, Healer, Wizard, Spearman

FAQ
- Blacksmith identifies undefined items
- Sell unwanted equipment at the Market or Auction
- Switch class by changing equipped weapon
- Dungeon mods raise exp and luck

PC Controls // Mobile & Console supported
Unsheath — Z
Attack — LMB
Block — F
Dash — Q
Class Skill — E
Skills — 1, 2, 3
HP Potion — 4
MP Potion — 5
Lock — Shift
